description: This file contains utility functions for URL pattern matching, including glob to regex conversion, URL comparison, and URL resolution, used within the Playwright project.

methods.name: globToRegexPattern
methods.description: Converts a glob pattern string into a regex pattern string.

methods.name: isRegExp
methods.description: Type guard to check if an object is a RegExp.

methods.name: urlMatchesEqual
methods.description: Checks if two URLMatch patterns are equivalent.

methods.name: urlMatches
methods.description: Determines if a URL matches a given pattern, which can be string, RegExp, or function.

methods.name: resolveGlobToRegexPattern
methods.description: Resolves a glob pattern to a regex pattern, considering base URL and WebSocket URLs.

methods.name: toWebSocketBaseUrl
methods.description: Converts http/https base URLs to ws/wss URLs for WebSocket matching.

methods.name: resolveGlobBase
methods.description: Resolves glob patterns relative to a base URL, handling special URL schemes.

methods.name: parseURL
methods.description: Parses a string into a URL object, returns null if invalid.

methods.name: constructURLBasedOnBaseURL
methods.description: Constructs a full URL based on a base URL and a given URL string.

methods.name: resolveBaseURL
methods.description: Resolves a URL relative to a base URL, returning the absolute URL and origin.
